selection: Fixed official revisions, six families/app in order below. Inventory all endpoint-source files; select read forwarding, collection/selection and effects across >=3 endpoint classes. Other inventory methods not selected because this batch is bounded; never replace failures by successful methods.
disclosure: Source/dependency/environment review permitted and performed; no third-party blind claim. No TF plan or run on these tasks before new algorithm freeze.

ruoyi.independent_rule: Normal data.deptName copies the concrete selectDeptById return field. Data-scope reads select control only. Null data is a separate null-field target, not an element.
Each surviving element name copies its own mapper row field; removeIf changes membership, not the name source. Repeated names must keep different row coordinates.
Actual mapper or Redis read occurrence supplies each label. A cache hit is not attributed to an earlier absent mapper occurrence. Empty list has no member targets.
Value copies the concrete mapper return field. Missing record leaves null data; no value-based matching.
Each postName is its actual selectPostAll row field; deliberately equal names on distinct rows cannot merge. Six requests have fresh method/source occurrences.
On successful insert toAjax returns constant success code with empty data origins; row count and uniqueness affect selection. Save/logging effects remain obligations, not read-only summaries.

teastore.independent_rule: The copy constructor preserves each selected PersistenceProduct.name field from the concrete TypedQuery row. Category find supplies selection, not product name.
Price copies its own concrete selected row. Equal prices remain separate sources.
Repository maps its concrete matching PersistenceUser row into User; final copy preserves that realName. Missing user 404 is not a successful field.
Each totalPriceInCents copies the selected PersistenceOrder field, not a newly recomputed product sum; user find determines selection.
Inherited route dispatches to CategoryEndpoint; each copied category name uses its concrete query row. Runtime generic dispatch must be bound, not guessed.

Generated identifier has no declared root/read data source; generation requires actual generated-ID write fact. Preserve oracle-unavailable if not observed; persisted input fields are separate sink obligations.

fixture: Isolated original SQL/schema + six input cases. Seed nonempty rows, at least two distinct rows with equal selected values. Save every fixture diff and hash before original runs. Public application authentication only; no signing-material reads or invented admin JWT.
oracle: Logical copy/constant/selection rules above fixed before tools. Each JVM needs actual source-call start/completion and field/owner/version/target projection. DB values verify content but cannot supply missing physical coordinates. Labels/TF inference never generate truth.
compatibility: RuoYi host OpenJDK8u504; TeaStore JDK11/Tomcat10.0.27 official Dockerfile. Independent control probes allowed; no query compatibility trial planning. Missing model/runtime/transport => report unsupported, no registration or framework adaptation.
first_execution: After algorithm freeze only. Original, TF full/selective, applicable fixed MT. Keep complete pool statuses and unchanged logical source boundaries. Handler leaves and save/message sinks separately inventoried, not automatically counted as field success.
clarification_before_core_or_tools: TeaStore User source has realName, not firstName; protocol transcription corrected before any TF planning/run. Initial seal retained.
